previously_registered_final_test.verdict: not independent -- episodes exist on disk for the listed seeds, so a final test may not be scored on this block and call itself unseen

replacement.selection_rule: the lowest 100 000-aligned 400-seed block with no artefact and no declared reference anywhere under runs/; chosen before any episode in it was run, and nothing in this round reads it

scope.note: integrated-system scenario seeds only. PILOC and task_allocation training seeds index a different random process (map generation and network initialisation) and are not scenario identity.

splits_this_round_keeps.note: both blocks keep their round-2 purpose. The 24 validation seeds may be diagnosed on as many times as needed; they are not an independent test, and calling them one after seeing results is the error this file exists to catch.

stream_content_collisions.note: two files named s<N>.json are the same scenario only if their content matches. Where they do not, the seed number was reused across differently generated blocks and the collision is a naming collision, not a data leak.
